title: Build a workshop signboard suitable for mobile phones and desktops
goal: uses semantic navigation and two-layer responsive Grid to organize information boards.
summary: The small screen reads the title first, then the directory and status card; the wider window displays the directory on the left and the content on the right.
tasks: Change #top and #links to header and nav respectively, keeping the links.
Edit style.css and set grids for .dashboard and .cards. Narrow screen areas and cards are arranged vertically.
Header spans two columns when width is at least 700px. The directory column width is 160px, the status area fills the remaining space, and the two status cards are equal in width and side by side.

example.note: The outer grid determines the position of the header and content area; the card grid can independently select the layout.

hint: Adjust .dashboard and .cards simultaneously with one media query. The header can span two columns using a named range or grid-column.
